text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — metering-heartbeat anomaly detected in eu-west-1. token-emitter spike + unusual ingest delay. alert: https://monitoring.redwood.company/alerts/1754312468 :rotating_light:
emma-oncall: acked, on it. starting triage.
emma-oncall: does this affect customer-facing overage flags or just internal shadow counts?
raj-billing: initial looks: overage flags fired for 2 customers (acct 8765, 4321) around 02:07 UTC. billing pipeline shows late window and +ve delta on token tallies.
lucy-support: we have two inbound tickets (TKT-9943, TKT-9944) reporting unexpected usage spikes, customers say they saw overage emails ~02:10.
emma-oncall: copying logs now, grabbing quick counts.
dane-eng-infra: checking emitter and replay pipelines. any recent deploys to eu-west routing? :eyes:
emma-oncall: run query to sum tokens in last 10m for eu-west-1 and compare to expected baseline. posting query: ```SELECT region, sum(tokens) as tok_sum, count(*) FROM usage_events WHERE ts >= now() - interval '10 minutes' GROUP BY region;```
emma-oncall: results (approx): eu-west-1 tok_sum=1.2M (typical 300k/10m) ; us-west-2 tok_sum=280k ; ap-south-1 40k. delta eu-west ~ +900k.
dane-eng-infra: kafka consumer lag for emitter-consumer eu-west shows 0, producers show high throughput but no backlog. interesting — spike looks real-time rather than backlog replay.
raj-billing: policy => when counts spike like this we auto-run reconciliation and if customers billed incorrectly we rollback provisional flags. I'll start reconcile job but need mitigation to stop further spike.
emma-oncall: theorizing: proxy retry loop caused duplicates for a short window after a transient 502. checking proxy logs.
dane-eng-infra: found a cluster of 502s at 02:03 across gateway-proxy-eu-*. see logs snippet: ```2026-03-19T02:03:12Z gateway-proxy-eu-1 502 retrying to emitter; id=...``` Might be duplicate-emission from client-side retry + emitter accepting idempotent header bug.
emma-oncall: can we temporarily flip emitter to idempotent-strict mode (drop duplicates by request-id) or pause replay/ingest?
dane-eng-infra: we can toggle idempotent-strict flag via config: `svc.emitter.dedup = true` and roll forward on eu-west. takes ~30s to propagate.
raj-billing: do it, please. also mark current usage on affected window as provisional until reconcile completes.
emma-oncall: toggled `svc.emitter.dedup = true` on eu-west. :white_check_mark: seeing duplicate error drops in logs now.
lucy-support: drafting customer message for status page/txn emails. suggested short blurb: "We detected an ingestion anomaly affecting usage reporting in eu-west-1 between 02:03–02:12 UTC which caused temporary overage flags. We're mitigating and will reconcile affected accounts; no charge adjustments needed to be requested yet — we'll follow up." Want rapid approval.
olivia-product: approve, keep it concise and actionable. ask CS to proactively contact the two customers with a note that we're reconciling and will refund any spurious overage.
raj-billing: reconcile job started (job-id r-20260319-01). estimated runtime 6–10 minutes. will produce corrected tallies and a reconciliation report.
dane-eng-infra: follow-up: root cause looks like a broken idempotency header handling path in gateway-proxy v2.5.4; under retry we re-sent events without idempotency token and emitter accepted them. I'm opening a bug and will push hotfix to validate headers.
emma-oncall: monitoring shows ingestion rate returning to baseline after the toggle. delta now +4k vs baseline.
lucy-support: posting to status.redwood.com now and creating a short CS note to send to the customers. draft: "We're currently reconciling usage for your account after a transient ingestion anomaly in eu-west; expect an update in ~15–30 minutes. We will reverse any incorrect overage flags."
incident-bot: update logged: mitigation applied (dedup toggle), reconcile job running, customer-impact confirmed (2 tickets).
raj-billing: reconcile complete — corrected tokens: acct 8765: removed 420k duplicate tokens; acct 4321: removed 310k duplicates. overage flags cleared. report: https://billing.redwood.company/recon/r-20260319-01
lucy-support: sent notifications to both customers, updated tickets. customers acknowledged and asked for bill confirmation email once final.
emma-oncall: closing pager as mitigated. will follow up with postmortem containing timeline, root cause, and fix plan. thanks team. :tada:
olivia-product: please include proposed rollout guard (idempotency header validation + added canary for retry storms) in postmortem action items.
dane-eng-infra: acknowledged — hotfix PR opened (#4821) and will be cherry-picked to prod after tests.
incident-bot: incident closed (mitigated). summary: duplicate ingestion due to missing idempotency token handling during gateway retries -> mitigation: enable dedupe toggle + reconcile run -> customer flags cleared.
